NewsArticle.Title: Arms and Armor of Quality
NewsArticle.Content: Marlon, weaponsmith of Loures, writes: Ake, Ancient Dwarven smith, and Moire, Fae tailor, teach Aislings and mundanes new Tailoring and smithing techniques. These techniques make all quality weapons and clothing much lighter. QualityWeight Normal100% Good80% Fine60% Grand40% Great20% - Marlon Jean, acting Councilor of Loures, reminds: Arms are not allowed in Undine. Loures' mission depends on it. Jean Councilor of Loures
